For security findings, stop and follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Version and environment

App version/image digest, browser/version, OS, language and deployment mode:

## Question or reproducible problem

Use a minimal invented example. For bugs, list numbered steps and explain
expected versus actual behavior.

## Sanitized evidence

Optional redacted screenshots/logs only. Keep workspace backups private and
do not clear browser data before exporting a backup.
